name: Egypt
line: Egypt is the land of the Nile, where Abram fled a famine and Jacob's family settled, and from which God later brought Israel out.

moments.title: Abram goes down to Egypt
moments.text: A severe famine hit the land, so Abram went to Egypt for a while. He asked Sarai to say she was his sister, afraid the Egyptians would kill him for her.

moments.title: Jacob's family comes to Egypt
moments.text: Jacob's family came to Egypt, including two sons born to Joseph there. In all, seventy members of the family went to Egypt.

moments.title: The Nile turns to blood
moments.text: The fish in the Nile died and the river smelled so bad the Egyptians could not drink it. Egypt's magicians did the same, and Pharaoh's heart stayed hard.

moments.title: Isaiah's sign against Egypt
moments.text: The LORD had Isaiah go naked and barefoot for three years as a sign against Egypt and Cush. The king of Assyria would lead Egypt's captives away, and those who boasted in Egypt would be ashamed.

moments.title: A blessing for Egypt
moments.text: The LORD promised a day when Egypt and Assyria would worship together and join Israel in a blessing on the earth. He called Egypt "My people."
